description: unread filter toggles, combines with text and tags, and updates on read. Conversations {{UNREAD}} and {{READ}} both say "echo: unread filter needle" and are tagged unread-filter; {{READ}} has been read and {{UNREAD}} not. Call "read-unread" marks {{UNREAD}} read. The viewport is 1280x900, where the drawer stays open. Conversation rows are ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id='<id>']" ("the row of <id>"). "The toggle" is data-testid "unread-toggle", and its state is its aria-pressed attribute. "The panel" is data-testid "tag-filter-panel". The search query editor is the contenteditable element with data-testid "conversation-query-editor" ("the editor"); its data-query-value attribute is the serialized query. "The query is X" means data-query-value is exactly X, spaces included. To "set the query to X": eval the editor's focus(), press_key "a" with modifiers "Control" (the editor's own select-all), insert_text X (as pasting would), then wait until the query is X. To "clear the query": eval the editor's focus(), press_key "a" with modifiers "Control", press Backspace, then wait until the query is "". Query tokens are [data-conversation-query-token="<kind>"] elements inside the editor (kind tag or user); "the token T" is the one whose text contains T. Every selector you need is given here, so do not explore the source code or read other tests (the old Playwright spec is being replaced and does not apply): write all the steps in one run_steps call right away, and look something up only if a step fails. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is {"role": "button", "name": "X", "exact": true}, with a "selector" to scope it when it is a row's, a menu's or a group's; but "there is no button X" counts {"role": "button", "name": "X"} without exact, so that a name containing X counts too. Texts that "are exactly [...]" are checked with assert_texts. "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. 1. Navigate to /new and wait for data-testid "message-input" to be visible. 2. The row of {{UNREAD}} has the class conversation-item-unread, and the row of {{READ}} is visible. 3. Click the button "Search conversations...". 4. The toggle reads exactly "unread", and its aria-pressed is exactly "false". 5. Click the button "Add tag filter". 6. The panel is visible. 7. Click the toggle. 8. The panel is visible; the row of {{UNREAD}} is visible and the row of {{READ}} is not visible (assert_not_visible). 9. Set the query to "is:unread ". 10. The panel is not visible. 11. Click the button "Add tag filter". 12. The panel is visible, and the row of {{READ}} is not visible. 13. Click the toggle. 14. The panel is visible; the toggle's aria-pressed is exactly "false"; the row of {{READ}} is visible. 15. Set the query to "is:unread ". 16. The panel is not visible. 17. Click the button "Add tag filter". 18. The panel is visible, and the row of {{READ}} is not visible. 19. Click the button "Remove is:unread" inside the editor ({"selector": "[data-testid='conversation-query-editor']", "role": "button", "name": "Remove is:unread", "exact": true}). 20. The panel is visible; the toggle's aria-pressed is exactly "false"; the row of {{READ}} is visible. 21. Clear the query. 22. Click the toggle. 23. The query is "is:unread ". 24. The toggle's aria-pressed is exactly "true"; the row of {{UNREAD}} is visible and the row of {{READ}} is not visible. 25. Set the query to "is:unread tag:unread-filter needle". 26. The row of {{UNREAD}} is visible and the row of {{READ}} is not visible. 27. Click the toggle. 28. The query is "tag:unread-filter needle ". 29. The row of {{READ}} is visible. 30. Click the toggle. 31. The row of {{READ}} is not visible. 32. Call "read-unread". 33. The row of {{UNREAD}} is not visible. 34. Click "[data-testid='conversation-query-editor'] [data-conversation-query-token='unread'] .conversation-query-token-delete". 35. The toggle's aria-pressed is exactly "false"; the rows of {{UNREAD}} and {{READ}} are visible.
